notes.title: Version 1.1 - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Apologies for the delay in any bug fixes. Unfortunately school and work has been quite time consuming!

Nonetheless, a few issues with Night at the Office have come to my attention which are being addressed with this V.1.1 patch.

1) Ending 3 Bug - If you restart the game FROM THE BEGINNING after obtaining the ladder, a bug was preventing access to ending 3, as opposed to starting from the checkpoint. This has been fixed and ending 3 can now be accessed from both routes. Huge apologies to anybody affected by this!

2) Headache volume - The headache volume has been reduced by 50%. I understand that some people were literally getting a headache from this sound. Additionally, the chromatic aberration affect from the headache has also been adjusted to reduce significantly faster after taking the medication, so not to linger for too long afterwards.

3) Minor asset tweaks - An instance where a calendar in the game showed the year 2022 despite the game taking place in 2006. My apologies on that. Big oversight :D

Thank you everyone. And once again, apologies to anybody who was negatively affected by Night at the Office due to the above errors. The only affect I want this game to provide you is fear... not annoyance.

Cheers, everybody.

Stan. T
